full_census_shadow: Owner will run the full shards afterwards; only focused modes are included here.

process.scope: Unregistered prepared-book test harness with native pre-build; subprocess CPU includes startup and exit. Integrated finalized custody compares Python _compute_snapshot against native snapshot_load plus custody CPU spans; compute-only subtracts Python load and excludes native load. Stage-output destruction outside those spans stays in complete-process CPU. Complete payload, phase sequence and persisted scalar comparisons run outside timing.

custody_binding_diagnostics.scope: Python decision computation on a preloaded snapshot versus native binding including JSON parse, admission, response encoding and deferred native cleanup; database load, Python request encoding, comparison and destruction of returned results excluded from timing. Both modes use the same /proc task-settlement check.
custody_binding_diagnostics.qualification: Supplemental decision-only diagnostic binding round trip emits stage JSON; this is separate from the integrated finalized custody spans above.
